          PNG_SIGNATURE = b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
          
          def relocate_research_artifacts(source_root, destination_root):
              assert source_root.is_dir() and not source_root.is_symlink(), 'Original QA output root must be a real directory'
              assert {p.name for p in source_root.iterdir()} == set(RESEARCH_SCREENSHOT_NAMES), 'Only the two completed research QA directories may exist'
              assert not destination_root.exists() and not destination_root.is_symlink(), 'Never overwrite an existing artifact destination'
              assert destination_root.parent.is_dir() and not destination_root.parent.is_symlink(), 'Existing report artifact parent must be a real directory'
              manifest = []
              for folder, expected in RESEARCH_SCREENSHOT_NAMES.items():
                  directory = source_root / folder
                  assert directory.is_dir() and not directory.is_symlink(), 'Research QA directory must be real'
                  assert {p.name for p in directory.iterdir()} == set(expected), 'Every exact authored screenshot and no unexpected file must exist'
                  for name in expected:
                      image = directory / name
                      assert image.is_file() and not image.is_symlink(), 'Only regular authored PNG files may move'
                      data = image.read_bytes()
                      assert len(data) > 32 and data.startswith(PNG_SIGNATURE) and data[12:16] == b'IHDR', 'Every moved artifact must be a PNG image'
                      manifest.append({'path': folder + '/' + name, 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
              assert len(manifest) == 36 and len({row['path'] for row in manifest}) == 36, 'Exact36 authored screenshots required'
              destination_root.mkdir()
              for folder in RESEARCH_SCREENSHOT_NAMES:
                  shutil.move(str(source_root / folder), str(destination_root / folder))
              for row in manifest:
                  image = destination_root / row['path']
                  assert image.is_file() and not image.is_symlink(), 'Moved PNG remains a regular file'
                  data = image.read_bytes()
                  assert len(data) == row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == row['sha256'], 'Every screenshot byte and SHA256 must survive relocation'
              source_root.rmdir()
              return manifest
          
          manifest = relocate_research_artifacts(Path.cwd() / 'tmp', Path('/tmp/report-presentation-smoke/research-publication-screenshots'))
